primary_gt.computed_consequence: The ledger isolates a high burn-smoke signal while rainfall and heat counters remain below their trigger thresholds.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields including event and hazard windows, severity_bin high, and answer wildfire_burn_smoke_dominant.
criteria.name: requested_json_and_final_label
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for the correct answer with one or two missing fields.

criteria.description: Uses the burn-index formula and reports burn index within 1.0 of 44.91, dNBR mean within 0.02 of 0.329, dNBR max within 0.02 of 1.003, and alpha mean change within 0.002 of 0.02035.
criteria.name: burn_index_formula_and_values
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for the right formula with one incorrect or omitted metric.

criteria.description: Sets smoke air quality, smoke health, and out-of-control fire gates to true.
criteria.name: report_text_gates
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for two correct gates or for a correct smoke gate pair with the fire gate omitted.

criteria.description: Reports GPM 70.6 mm, CHIRPS 76.56 mm, ERA5 precipitation 136.35 mm, peak Tmax 19.06 C, mean Tmax 16.64 C, identifies the 2023-05-01 to 2023-06-15 hazard diagnostic window, and marks rainfall and heat counters as zero.
criteria.name: counter_metrics_and_thresholds
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct threshold states with one or two missing numeric values.

criteria.description: Reports WorldPop population near 175.7, fire-station count 1, trunk-road count 15, and local_context score 3.
criteria.name: local_context_score
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for two correct local context inputs or a correct score with one missing input.

criteria.description: Computes burn_smoke 8, rainfall 0, heat 0, weak_signal 0, margin 8, and dominance_rule_pass true.
criteria.name: score_arithmetic_and_dominance
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for one arithmetic error that does not change the final answer.

criteria.description: Provides a one-sentence consequence tied to the ledger, with no added casualty, health-burden, evacuation, or loss totals.
criteria.name: computed_consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a correct but verbose consequence.
